title: Many Hands
location: Underground Resistance HQ — a multi-species holdout beneath the ruined city
summary: Salvari aren't the only ones the Overlord tried to file away. A resistance is forming underground from a dozen species who agree on exactly one thing. Make them agree on a second.
_hooks: Canon L18 Underground Resistance — the multi-species alliance / companion-arc beat. give-gated on salvari.allied + act2.heart_done (so it lands after the player has proven themselves to the Salvari and seen the Biomesh truth). Reuses the Nordic Steward as the player's in (mentor tree, m_resistance node). The dispute resolution branches on karma (unity vs strong-arm) and grants alliances via the existing onAllyJoined (ally:true). act2.alliance_formed gates the Storm Runner climax and the late-game ending math (ally count scales L100). Chains into act2_storm_runner.
_voice: Grief politics done with restraint. 'Nobody here agrees on whose loss counts most' is the whole tragedy. The unity path costs nothing; the strong-arm path works but is quietly poisoned (trust down).

stages.objective: Reach the resistance HQ. The Nordic Steward vouches for you; that gets you in the door, not the room.
Three factions, three grievances. Hear them all before you pick a fight for them.
They'll only unite behind someone who's bled for more than one of them. Settle the dispute that's keeping them apart.

args.text: Everyone here lost a world. Nobody here agrees on whose loss counts most.

stages.objective: You give them a reason instead of an order. Three species stand up at once.
You make them an offer they're too scared to refuse. They follow. They don't love you for it.
The alliance forms, ragged but real.
An Overlord push hits the HQ while the ink's still wet. Hold the line together.

args.text: First fight as one. Make it count, or the alliance dies in its cradle.

stages.objective: The HQ holds. For the first time, the war has a 'we' in it that isn't just you and the people you carried out of a basement.
